progress.instructions: Classify whether the recent bounded work materially advanced the stated objective, using only the supplied step summaries and deterministic progress markers.

criteria.progressing: Recent steps produced new useful evidence, completed a required subgoal, or measurably reduced the remaining work.
criteria.stalled: Recent steps repeat substantially the same failed approach or produce no new useful state toward the objective.
criteria.unclear: The supplied state is too sparse or mixed to determine progress reliably.

state.deterministicProgress: previously failing focused test now passes

recentSteps: Retried the same command and received the same parse error.
Retried the same command again with no input or code change.
state.deterministicProgress: no tracked state or test result changed
